summary: Frontend-only validation of pagination + cash-in prefill UX in /admin/staking. Stakings pager and header widgets work perfectly. Wallets tab has a CRITICAL BUG: the 'Acciones' column header is present but the row body cells are missing — the 'Nueva solicitud' button per row is NOT rendered, so the entire prefill flow is broken.

ui_bugs.issue: The <thead> declares 6 columns including 'Acciones' (line 426), but each <tbody> <tr> only renders 5 <td>: prosperId, email, cashin, address, integration. The <td> containing the 'Nueva solicitud' button with data-testid staking-wallet-cashin-btn-{i} is MISSING. Result: 0 cashin buttons in the DOM; prefill flow cannot be triggered from the UI.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised because the button is not rendered on any row. Programmatic verification of onRequestCashin(email) → initialProsperId was blocked by the missing button.

action_items: In frontend/src/app/admin/staking/page.tsx WalletsTab (around line 456-458), add a <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right"> containing a button that calls onRequestCashin(r.email || r.prosperId || '') with data-testid={`staking-wallet-cashin-btn-${i}`}. Disable/hide when r.email is missing to avoid empty prefill.

After the fix, re-verify: (a) button visible on every row, (b) click → tab switches to 'Nueva solicitud' with staking-cashin-prosperid pre-filled with the row's email, (c) manual open of the tab (no row click) keeps input empty.
critical_code_review_comments: WalletsTab: thead/tbody column count mismatch — header declares 'Acciones' but tbody omits the corresponding cell (page.tsx line 426 vs 430-457).
Pager component correctly hides itself when total <= PAGE_SIZE (verified with Stakings 13 rows → shows; Wallets <=10 rows → hides).
NewCashinTab key={cashinPrefill || 'manual'} correctly remounts on prefill change; verified manual reopen resets input to empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified passing: (1) admin-staking-page loads, (2) Stakings pager works: '1–10 de 13' page1 with prev disabled, click Siguiente → '11–13 de 13' page2 with 3 rows, (3) filter reset to page 1 works (ARSa filter hides pager because <=10 results), (4) Wallets search filters (query 'qa-cuenta' → 1 row, pager hidden), (5) header widgets USDC + ARSa + Sync present, XLM absent, (6) manual open of 'Nueva solicitud' tab keeps input empty. FAILING: the per-row 'Nueva solicitud' button in Wallets CMS is not rendered because the <td> is missing in tbody, blocking the entire prefill flow. Main agent must add that <td> with the button and data-testid staking-wallet-cashin-btn-{i}.
rca of the issue: In frontend/src/app/admin/staking/page.tsx WalletsTab, the was updated to add an 'Acciones' column (line 426) but the developer forgot to add the matching with the 'Nueva solicitud' button inside the pageItems.map row template (should be after line 456, before ). Because the button is what wires onRequestCashin → goToCashin → setCashinPrefill(email), no email prefill can occur from the UI. Fix: append a before the closing .
